### 2. Act / wait / refuse at 2026-10-19 14:40 PDT
Plan 0d182581… `Harborline Pro, active, billing_term_months 36, term_start_date 2026-10-22, term_end_date 2029-10-22, first_term False, auto_renew True`; the 36-month term was bought by auto-renew line 007ace28… 582.88, card, charge_date 2026-10-15, period 2026-10-22..2029-10-22. Early renewal doc: "An early renewal is not billed until the plan's term start date is on or before today. While the plan's term start date is later than today, no early renewal is billed." Term start 22 Oct > today -> a one-year renewal cannot be billed now. The auto-renew refund window is open: charge 15 Oct + 15 calendar days (cancellation_and_refund_terms_by_tier: 15) -> last day 30 Oct; 36-month term (>=12), auto-renew, paid by card. Act now: refund, then early renewal.

### 4. Computations
**A. Auto-renew refund amount** (auto_renew_refund_amount_calculation: full line amount less keep-backs, never below zero).
- Line 582.88.
- Multi-year commitment share factor: 36-month line -> tier's 1-month price once: Pro 25.99.
- Processor fee factor: card, refunded after its charge date -> 2.9 % of 582.88 = 16.90352 -> 16.90.
- Handling fee factor: 4 whole days from 15 Oct to 19 Oct (>3, <=9) -> 9.00.
- Reversal fee factor: applied term change request effective on the line's period start -> 15.00.
- Refund = 582.88 − 66.89 = **515.99**. Fall-back: 582.88.
- Post-state (tool description): term 2025-10-22..2026-10-22, billing term 12, auto_renew false; earlier term end not passed -> no closure.

**B. Early renewal amount** (early_renewal_at_checkout: term end later than today, no scheduled downgrade or term change request — the only request is `applied`).
- New term length: current billing term 12 (customer wants one year; consistent).
- Regular price: Pro regular 12-month 21.99 × 12 = 263.88.
- Reseller discount factor (early): Bronze 10 % -> 237.492 -> 237.49.
- Early renewal credit factor: auto-renew off (after the refund), 3 whole days to 22 Oct (<30) -> 4.00.
- Certificate credit factor: one active DV only -> 6.00.
- Domain bundle credit factor: 17.64/1 = 17.64 (keyed on the registration naming the plan, not on the primary domain).
- Mail bundle credit factor: 3 seats (<5) -> 10.00 (conditional, email).
- Credits 37.64 (< half of 237.49) -> **199.85**. Fall-back: 263.88.

2. unlock_agent_discoverable_tool + call `refund_hosting_auto_renewal_84b3efde`(hosting_id 0d182581-ad90-4c49-83b1-ffdf2a10d7e1, original_hosting_charge_id 007ace28-3c3b-4cb6-9198-1467118b0a79, amount 515.99) [agent].

Terminal: refund line −515.99 to card; plan term 2026-10-22..2027-10-22, 12 months, auto-renew off (left as is by the renewal).

### 6. Problem tree
- Root: one-year early renewal (customer's own checkout write).
- Hop 1 — **state-derived**: early renewal sentence "An early renewal is not billed until the plan's term start date is on or before today." + record term_start_date 2026-10-22 > today. Searching "term start date"/"term paid before": auto_renew_refunds_and_term_rollback "Refunding the auto-renew charge rolls the plan back to the term paid before it, meaning that term's start date, end date and billing term length, with auto-renew switched off" -> restores start 2025-10-22 <= today. Refund rule has no prerequisite sentence; window open.
- Order: refund -> early renewal (and the refund also turns auto-renew off, which sets the early renewal credit tier, and makes the billing term 12).
- Counter-proof "do only the renewal": the sentence forbids billing an early renewal while term start is later than today; a one-year renewal on top of the 36-month term is not billable.
- Alternatives excluded: scheduling a term change (not a renewal now; takes effect at term end 2029); overdue pricing (term end later than today); auto-renew-on credit tier (rollback switches it off); 12.00 certificate credit (only DV active; OV absent, expired DV not counted); no mail credit (subscription is on the primary domain jandreauweb.ca); handling fee nothing (4 days > 3); processor fee nil (not same day).
